While infiltrating the [[ISB Central Office/Legends|ISB Headquarters]], [[Jax Pavan]], disguised as [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Police]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pel Kwinn]], tried to go through Airspace Control, only for a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] '''Inquisitor''' in a hood exited it. Jax, trying not to be [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] by the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] by getting too closed, moved away, pretending to be contacted by a higher up over his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and walking away. Jax made his way down another corridor and through arched windows saw the Inquisitor not hesitate and exited the hall without a nod to the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] at the checkpoint.<ref name="Last Jedi" />
